units.source_text: 送葬人爬上了梯田，朝竹林子这边走过来。

en.t: The funeral bearers climbed up the terraced fields and came walking toward the bamboo grove.

units.source_text: 阿笑平平稳稳地趴在地上，用双手托着那张扁平的脸庞，笑眯眯地凝望着这般情景。

en.t: A-Xiao lay calmly on the ground, holding up her flat face with both hands, and gazed at the scene with a smile.
